title: Faction, Settlement, World & Campaign Consequence Integration
objective: Implement a visibility-first deterministic read-only strategic-consequence integration projection over explicit canonical faction, settlement, world and campaign owner records without synthesizing or mutating owner-domain consequences.

canonical_owner_surfaces: ODL-07 identity-preserving settlement/faction SCL link handoff
rules: Visibility filters before consequence inclusion, counts, target/reference lists, summaries, search, provenance, handoffs, deterministic receipts or AI context; hidden existence/cardinality is undisclosed.

Every represented strategic consequence requires an explicit visible canonical owner observation with stable consequence id, target kind/reference, owner authority/reference, source SCL result/reference, context, provenance and visibility references.
SCL-10 may reconcile repeated visible observations of the same consequence reference and emit deterministic read-only owner-handoff lines; it never creates the owner consequence itself.

No battle/order/objective/casualty result automatically changes faction standing, settlement control/status, world state, campaign state or campaign time. Explicit canonical owner consequence evidence is required.

The sealed sources/current contracts provide no universal reputation, control, territory, resource, settlement, world or campaign consequence conversion formula; this remains an explicit source gap rather than an invented mechanic.
Missing, hidden, unknown, conflict or incompatible evidence remains unresolved and is never guessed or AI-reconciled.
Duplicate visible canonical consequence identity with incompatible owner/target/source tuples makes completeness false rather than being silently merged.
Stable IDs/orderings and deterministic receipts are required; deterministic ordering creates no authority or priority.
SCL-11 retains workbench, scenario packs, balance and cross-scale golden proof.

invalidation_events: required validation reports a materially new failure signature

validation_requirement: Exactly one SCL-10 current-family profile, zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine matching self-hosted Linux/Windows acceptance RED before production mutation, then exact-head Linux/Windows GREEN and deterministic comparison.
